work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Motu proprio CCX separates lower Egypt from the Custody of the Holy Land and upper Egypt and Arabia from the vicariate of Aleppo and erects a Latin vicariate apostolic for Egypt and Arabia; LF44604 → LF44613 across own provenance LF44607 and running title LF44610; complete 17 May 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF44551–44551; the source closing at LF44621–44624 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima septima maii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pon- tificatus Nostri anno nono.. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
